subject: 5-Bullet Friday — Musical Genius, Diamond Detectives, Training Fat Cells to Starve Cancer, and More

bullets.title: Graceland
bullets.creator: Paul Simon
bullets.note:
. My most-listened-to album of 2025. It’s been on many “top 100 best albums ever” lists over the decades. It’s my default wake-up-and-smile music in the morning when making coffee, etc.  
​  
+  
​  
​**“**[**The Story of ‘Graceland,’ as Told by Paul Simon**](https://youtu.be/ZHaGhF_vhjk?si=DFrea6EhFOWn0Nwj)**”** ([YouTube](https://youtu.be/ZHaGhF_vhjk?si=DFrea6EhFOWn0Nwj), [Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/track/6qxXWHksQRKpRAjxzuS0Vs?si=ChW2QM0ZSP2BzrwWkrNaEg), [Apple Music](https://music.apple.com/us/song/the-story-of-graceland-as-told-by-paul-simon/581741639)) by [Paul Simon](https://www.instagram.com/paulsimonofficial/), from the [_Graceland_ (25th Anniversary Deluxe Edition)](https://www.amazon.com/Graceland-Paul-Simon/dp/B0002EQ7E2/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20) album. I know music is nuanced, but I’m a muggle non-musician. This layer-by-layer explanation shows just how much talent and iteration goes into making a Paul Simon track.

bullets.title: Nothing Lasts Forever
bullets.note: ([Paramount+](https://www.paramountplus.com/movies/video/9jgijEgXLUDr5SLpSE9flcb5QMz87EJZ/), [Amazon Prime Video](https://www.amazon.com/Nothing-Lasts-Forever-Dusan-Simic/dp/B0CN9PX5J5/?tag=offsitoftimfe-20)). Hat tip to [Deepa](https://x.com/deeparocks/status/1997751015609913819) for this recommendation. The description: “Hidden from public view, a war is raging inside the diamond industry. When filmmaker [Jason Kohn](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm1161623/) infiltrates this highly secretive world, he uncovers a vast, far-reaching crime that threatens the value of every diamond ever mined. At stake is nothing less than the universal symbol of love and commitment—the engagement ring. Featuring some of the most colorful and powerful industry insiders, _Nothing Lasts Forever_ launches us deep inside a criminal investigation and forces us to reconsider the creation of value itself.” Watch the trailer [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nHIGGdxZe64).

bullets.title: Tongues_, Volume 1
bullets.creator: Anders Nilsen
bullets.note:
. This blew my mind. If you like the idea of something like [_Syriana_](https://www.rottentomatoes.com/m/syriana) + Greek mythology + beautiful bizarreness, this is for you. It’s hard for me to conceive of how Anders even made this. The art will transport you to another dimension, or perhaps into an altered state. The blurbs and coverage all sound something like this: “Mind-bendingly good. It’s up there with _Maus, Fun Home, Persepolis, Jimmy Corrigan_.” — Mark Haddon, author of _The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time_.

​  
The 4.3 stars on Amazon makes no sense for anyone who explores graphic novels. Should be 4.8 minimum, IMHO. That said, it might resonate more if you’ve done copious amounts of drugs, so there is that!

bullets.title: How Hungry Fat Cells Could Someday Starve Cancer to Death
bullets.note: (_UCSF News_). Here’s the punchline: “Scientists transformed energy-storing white fat cells into calorie-burning ‘beige’ fat. Once implanted, they outcompeted tumors for resources, beating back five different types of cancer in lab experiments.”
